entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`id` TEXT NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `type` TEXT NOT NULL, `folderPath` TEXT NOT NULL, `pinned` INTEGER NOT NULL, `color` TEXT, `tags` TEXT NOT NULL, `created` INTEGER NOT NULL, `modified` INTEGER NOT NULL, `checksum` TEXT NOT NULL, `bodyPreview` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))

contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_note_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `note_index` BEGIN DELETE FROM `note_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_note_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `note_index` BEGIN DELETE FROM `note_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_note_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `note_index` BEGIN INSERT INTO `note_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `bodyPreview`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`bodyPreview`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_note_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `note_index` BEGIN INSERT INTO `note_fts`(`docid`, `title`, `bodyPreview`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`title`, NEW.`bodyPreview`); END
entities.createSql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`title` TEXT NOT NULL, `bodyPreview` TEXT NOT NULL, content=`note_index`)
